standard: An entry requires two independently verified records and no stated conclusion. Record A is an official House or Senate roll-call XML file showing the member as Not Voting. Record B is a qualifying primary source that names that member at a specific event on the same date (organizer event page or official release; the member's official site, press release, or verified social post; or an official public schedule). News reports alone do not qualify. The wording of every published entry follows the fixed template.
